Strong is a skill. I teach it.

I spent five seasons as a competitive lifter in the 69-kilo class, which mostly taught me how much of strength is patience. In the winter of 2015 I tore the meniscus in my left knee at nationals. The year of rehab that followed was the best coaching education I could have bought — I learned what a plan has to survive: bad weeks, shift work, fear of the bar.

My first clients were the people rehabbing next to me. Then their training partners. Then the partners' colleagues from the night shift. I have coached in the same industrial gym in Wilhelmsburg ever since — since 2023 from my own corner of it: two platforms and the board by the door.

I am not interested in transforming anybody in twelve weeks. I am interested in what your deadlift, your knees and your Tuesdays look like in week twelve — and whether you are still training in week fifty-two. The board by the platform keeps the record. Chalk doesn't exaggerate.

Asked often.

I have never lifted. Is this for me?

Yes — a third of Lena's clients start with the empty bar. The first session is a movement screen and a conversation, not a test. Loads start where your technique is, not where an app thinks it should be.

I have an old injury. Can I train?

Usually — with the plan built around it. Lena's own meniscus is why half her programmes exist. Bring your physio's notes; if something needs medical clearance first, she will tell you before taking any money.

My shifts change every week. How does scheduling work?

Blocks are booked as sessions per week, not fixed slots. You confirm your times each Sunday for the week ahead; the night-shift group has run exactly this way for two years.

What exactly is included in a block?

Twelve weeks: the coached sessions you choose, your programme on the board and in a paper log, weekly video check-ins for online clients, and testing in weeks 1 and 12 — so progress is measured, not guessed.

Can I pause or cancel a block?

Pause once for up to three weeks — illness and shift chaos are real. Cancel before week three and unused sessions are refunded; after that, they convert to online coaching.
